explication: Black Hole Sim is an interactive OpenGL visualization project. Users manipulate a camera or 2D viewport, then choose among CPU geodesic lensing, GPU-accelerated 3D ray tracing, and simpler scene ray tracing. Physics produces ray or geodesic results; GPU buffers and shaders accelerate the 3D path; OpenGL presents the resulting image or spacetime grid. The repository also contains accretion-disk parameters and a separate generic ray-tracing demo. Some shader wiring is inferred from documented usage and sampled host code.
